k25: Do you recognise yourself in one of these situations?
k26:
When everything seems stuck,
something is holding it back
k27:
There are blocks that no advice can dissolve.
Those are the ones I have worked on for over twenty years.
k29: Swift return of the person, even when the bond has been seriously damaged by meddling third parties.
k31: Families falling apart, broken relationships with children, homes filled with tensions no one can explain.
k33: Tiredness that never passes, insomnia, the feeling of being watched or drained. When the body is fine but something weighs on you.
k35: Businesses losing customers for no reason, disloyal partners, fortunes that turn from one month to the next.
k37: Business and investments in Italy and abroad: readings of opportunities, favourable timing, people you can trust.
k39: Properties unsold for years, negotiations that always collapse at the last moment, buyers who vanish without explanation.
k42: They say he was born on a moonless night, in a village that barely appears on maps. His grandmother kept him awake until dawn and taught him to read the wax, the smoke, the way a flame bends when a bad thought enters the house. He was seven the first time he pointed at a door and said: «envy came through there». Nobody laughed.
k43: At twenty he left everything and crossed three continents. He studied with elders who would not be photographed, in rooms where time was measured in burnt-down candles. He brought home a hand-bound notebook, ancient rituals he still guards today, and a rule he has never broken: never promise what cannot be achieved.
k44: «Destiny is not a sentence. It is a closed door. And every closed door has a key.»
k45: For over twenty years he has received those who have already knocked on every door: businessmen at their last negotiation, mothers who no longer recognise their children, women who only ask to sleep peacefully. He works at night, with candles lit and mirrors covered, because he says that is when things show themselves for what they truly are.
k46: He does not put on a show. He does not publish faces or names. Those who have met him tell one person at a time — and usually that person, sooner or later, calls.
k50: For bonds broken by third parties, sudden distances, silences lasting for months. We work on the thread that unites two people.
k55: You tell me your case by phone or on WhatsApp. No judgement, no rush. Everything stays between us.
k57: Feasibility analysis: I look at whether and how I can intervene. If there is nothing to work on, I will tell you.
k59: I prepare the work to measure, with the timing and materials your case requires. I explain every step.
k61: We stay in touch in the following weeks. The work is followed until the situation has stabilised.
k66:
The voices of those who
reopened the door
k67: «Eight months of total silence. The Master promised me nothing, he just told me what he would do. Three weeks later the phone rang.»
k68: «The company had been losing orders for a year for no logical reason. After the Master's work things started moving again. I don't really believe in it, but numbers are numbers.»
k69: «The house was unbearable, arguments every evening over nothing. After the cleansing you can breathe. My son has started talking to me again.»
k73: No free consultations are given. A feasibility analysis of the case is carried out, to understand together whether and how it is possible to intervene.
k75: Yes. The Master follows cases throughout Italy and abroad, by phone and on WhatsApp. There is no need to travel.
k76: How long does it take to see results?
k77: It depends on the case and on how deeply rooted the situation is. Some works show signs within a few days, others take weeks. Certain dates are never given.
k79: Always. No names, no stories and no photographs are ever shared. Discretion is part of the work.
k80: How does the first contact work?
k81: You call or write on WhatsApp and describe the situation in your own words. From there the Master tells you whether the case is one he works on.
k82: Does the Master accept every case?
k83: No. Some cases are turned down, others referred elsewhere. Never promise what cannot be achieved.
k85: Every day, including evenings. If the line is busy, write on WhatsApp: you will get a reply the same day.
